title: Branch and prune: stop taking your agent's first idea
description: Stop letting your coding agent run with the first idea it spits out, that first answer is almost never the best one. The real move is branch and prune. You fan out a bunch of adversarial variations through sub agents, each one told to disagree with the others, then you or another model picks the strongest design. Works for architecture, for features, for UI, even for copywriting. It gets even better when you mix models, Gemini for one branch, Codex for another, Claude for the third. I turned this whole thing into a skill my agents run every single day. Comment branch and I will send it over.
